annotations.title: Keyword search over the product index

description: Raw full-text search over the same index, without LLM ranking: fast, cheap, more candidates. Use for broad discovery or to judge fit yourself. Pass 3-16 English keywords: the job to be done, product category, synonyms, key technical nouns (e.g. ["transcription", "call notes", "crm", "sales"]). Candidates matching more distinct keywords rank higher.

source.description: Limit to one source: yc (startups), github (open source), hn (Show HN launches).

name: search_products

language.description: Main programming language of a repo.

last_seen_year.description: Year the repo last trended or the Show HN launched.

matched_terms.description: How many of the given terms matched.
